# Driftbox

> Multi-user cloud storage that compresses and encrypts every file on upload.

This is a client-rendered React single-page application with a Rust backend. Only the
pages listed below are reachable without authentication; everything under /user requires
a signed-in session.

## Pages

- [Home](http://localhost:3000/): Application landing page
- [Sign in](http://localhost:3000/auth/login): Session login
- [Register](http://localhost:3000/auth/register): Account creation
- [Terms of Service](http://localhost:3000/legal/terms): Placeholder terms of service for this proof of concept
- [Legal mentions](http://localhost:3000/legal/mentions): Placeholder publisher, hosting and personal-data notice
